// Legge la richiesta (Unity o pannello web) e prepara la query SQL.
// action: save_asset | register_asset | list_assets | delete_asset | save_scene | list_scenes | load_scene
//         | rename_scene | delete_scene | reindex | enrich_assets
const b = $input.first().json.body ?? $input.first().json;
const action = String(b.action ?? '').toLowerCase();
const ACTIONS = ['save_asset', 'register_asset', 'list_assets', 'delete_asset', 'save_scene', 'list_scenes', 'load_scene',
                 'rename_scene', 'delete_scene', 'reindex', 'enrich_assets'];
if (!ACTIONS.includes(action)) throw new Error(`Azione sconosciuta: "${action}"`);

const uuid = () => 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, c => {
  const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
  return (c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8)).toString(16);
});

const payload = { ...b };
delete payload.thumb_base64;            // la miniatura va nello storage, non nel database
let route = action;

if (action === 'save_asset') {
  if (b.asset_id) {
    route = 'update_asset';             // già sul server: aggiorna i dati / lo mette nell'inventario
  } else {
    if (!b.source_glb) throw new Error('save_asset: manca source_glb (percorso del GLB su ComfyUI)');
    payload.id = uuid();
    payload.glb_key   = `assets/${payload.id}/model.glb`;
    payload.image_key = b.source_image ? `assets/${payload.id}/image.png` : '';
    payload.thumb_key = b.thumb_base64 ? `assets/${payload.id}/thumb.jpg` : '';
  }
}
if (action === 'register_asset') {
  // il pannello web ha già caricato i file nello storage con questo id: si controlla che i percorsi siano quelli attesi
  const id = String(b.id ?? '').toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(id)) throw new Error('register_asset: id non valido');
  const base = `assets/${id}/`;
  if (b.glb_key !== base + 'model.glb') throw new Error('register_asset: glb_key non valido');
  if (b.thumb_key && b.thumb_key !== base + 'thumb.jpg') throw new Error('register_asset: thumb_key non valido');
  if (b.image_key && !['image.png', 'image.jpg'].map(f => base + f).includes(b.image_key)) throw new Error('register_asset: image_key non valido');
  payload.id = id;
  payload.in_inventory = true;
}
if (action === 'list_assets' && String(b.q ?? '').trim() !== '' && b.scope !== 'scene_only') route = 'search';   // ricerca semantica (Qdrant)
if (action === 'save_scene' && !b.scene_id) payload.new_id = uuid();
if (action === 'delete_asset' && !b.asset_id) throw new Error('delete_asset: manca asset_id');
if (['load_scene', 'rename_scene', 'delete_scene'].includes(action) && !b.scene_id) throw new Error(`${action}: manca scene_id`);

const p = JSON.stringify(payload).split('$xrq$').join('');   // il JSON va dentro $xrq$...$xrq$ (nessun escape necessario)
const Q = {
  "update_asset": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j),
up AS (
  UPDATE xr.assets a SET
    name        = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.j->>'name',''), a.name),
    category    = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.j->>'category',''), a.category),
    style       = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.j->>'style',''), a.style),
    tags        = CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(p.j->'tags','[]'::jsonb)) > 0
                       THEN ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p.j->'tags')) ELSE a.tags END,
    prompt_it   = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.j->>'prompt_it',''), a.prompt_it),
    width_cm    = COALESCE(NULLIF((p.j->>'width_cm')::real, 0), a.width_cm),
    height_cm   = COALESCE(NULLIF((p.j->>'height_cm')::real, 0), a.height_cm),
    depth_cm    = COALESCE(NULLIF((p.j->>'depth_cm')::real, 0), a.depth_cm),
    in_inventory = a.in_inventory OR COALESCE((p.j->>'in_inventory')::boolean, false),
    deleted_at  = NULL,
    updated_at  = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE a.id = (p.j->>'asset_id')::uuid
  RETURNING a.id, name, category, style, tags, prompt_it, prompt_en, object_name, model,
       glb_key, image_key, thumb_key, width_cm, height_cm, depth_cm, glb_bytes,
       author, in_inventory, use_count, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM up)
            THEN json_build_object('ok', true, 'asset', (SELECT row_to_json(up) FROM up))
            ELSE json_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'Oggetto non trovato') END AS result;",
  "list_assets": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j),
f AS (
  SELECT a.*,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.j->>'q','') <> ''
              THEN GREATEST(similarity(a.name, p.j->>'q'),
                            word_similarity(p.j->>'q', a.name || ' ' || a.prompt_it || ' ' || a.object_name)) ELSE 0 END AS score
  FROM xr.assets a, p
  WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND a.in_inventory = (COALESCE(p.j->>'scope','') <> 'scene_only')
    AND (COALESCE(p.j->>'category','') = '' OR a.category = p.j->>'category')
    AND (COALESCE(p.j->>'style','')    = '' OR a.style    = p.j->>'style')
),
page AS (
  SELECT id, name, category, style, tags, prompt_it, prompt_en, object_name, model,
       glb_key, image_key, thumb_key, width_cm, height_cm, depth_cm, glb_bytes,
       author, in_inventory, use_count, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, round(score::numeric, 3)::real AS score
  FROM f, p
  WHERE COALESCE(p.j->>'q','') = '' OR score >= COALESCE(NULLIF((p.j->>'min_score')::real, 0), 0.3)
  ORDER BY score DESC, f.created_at DESC
  LIMIT  (SELECT LEAST(COALESCE(NULLIF((j->>'limit')::int, 0), 24), 100) FROM p)
  OFFSET (SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE((j->>'offset')::int, 0), 0) FROM p)
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'ok', true,
  'mode',   CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT j->>'q' FROM p),'') = '' THEN 'list' ELSE 'text' END,
  'items',  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(page) FROM page), '[]'::json),
  'total',  (SELECT count(*) FROM f, p WHERE COALESCE(p.j->>'q','') = '' OR f.score >= COALESCE(NULLIF((p.j->>'min_score')::real, 0), 0.3)),
  'styles', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(DISTINCT style ORDER BY style) FROM xr.assets
                      WHERE in_inventory AND deleted_at IS NULL AND style <> ''), '[]'::json)
) AS result;",
  "delete_asset": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j),
up AS (
  UPDATE xr.assets a SET
    in_inventory = false,
    updated_at   = now(),
    deleted_at   = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xr.scene_objects so JOIN xr.scenes s ON s.id = so.scene_id
                                     WHERE so.asset_id = a.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL)
                        THEN NULL ELSE now() END
  FROM p
  WHERE a.id = (p.j->>'asset_id')::uuid
  RETURNING a.id
)
SELECT json_build_object('ok', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM up)) AS result;",
  "save_scene": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO xr.scenes (id, name, author, object_count, extras)
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'scene_id','')::uuid, (j->>'new_id')::uuid),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'name',''), 'Scena'), COALESCE(j->>'author',''),
         jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(j->'objects','[]'::jsonb)), COALESCE(j->>'extras','')
  FROM p
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, object_count = EXCLUDED.object_count, extras = EXCLUDED.extras,
                                 updated_at = now(), deleted_at = NULL
  RETURNING id, name
),
del AS (DELETE FROM xr.scene_objects WHERE scene_id = (SELECT id FROM up)),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO xr.scene_objects (scene_id, asset_id, px, py, pz, rx, ry, rz, rw, scale, placed_by)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM up), o.asset_id, o.px, o.py, o.pz, o.rx, o.ry, o.rz, o.rw, COALESCE(o.scale, 1), COALESCE(o.placed_by, '')
  FROM p, jsonb_to_recordset(COALESCE(p.j->'objects','[]'::jsonb))
       AS o(asset_id uuid, px real, py real, pz real, rx real, ry real, rz real, rw real, scale real, placed_by text)
  RETURNING asset_id
),
used AS (
  UPDATE xr.assets SET use_count = use_count + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT DISTINCT asset_id FROM ins) RETURNING id
)
SELECT json_build_object('ok', true, 'scene_id', (SELECT id FROM up), 'name', (SELECT name FROM up),
                         'saved', (SELECT count(*) FROM ins)) AS result;",
  "list_scenes": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j)
SELECT json_build_object('ok', true, 'scenes', COALESCE((
  SELECT json_agg(s ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC) FROM (
    SELECT id, name, author, object_count,
           to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at
    FROM xr.scenes WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    LIMIT LEAST(COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT (j->>'limit')::int FROM p), 0), 50), 200)
  ) s), '[]'::json)) AS result;",
  "load_scene": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j),
s AS (SELECT id, name, author, extras FROM xr.scenes, p WHERE id = (p.j->>'scene_id')::uuid AND deleted_at IS NULL)
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s)
       THEN json_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'Scena non trovata')
       ELSE json_build_object('ok', true, 'scene', (SELECT row_to_json(s) FROM s), 'objects', COALESCE((
         SELECT json_agg(o ORDER BY o.oid) FROM (
           SELECT so.id AS oid, a.id AS asset_id, a.name, a.object_name, a.prompt_it, a.prompt_en, a.category, a.style,
                  a.glb_key, a.image_key, a.thumb_key, a.in_inventory, a.width_cm, a.height_cm, a.depth_cm,
                  so.px, so.py, so.pz, so.rx, so.ry, so.rz, so.rw, so.scale, so.placed_by
           FROM xr.scene_objects so JOIN xr.assets a ON a.id = so.asset_id
           WHERE so.scene_id = (SELECT id FROM s)
         ) o), '[]'::json)) END AS result;",
  "delete_scene": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j),
up AS (UPDATE xr.scenes SET deleted_at = now() FROM p WHERE id = (p.j->>'scene_id')::uuid AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id)
SELECT json_build_object('ok', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM up)) AS result;",
  "reindex": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j)
SELECT json_build_object('ok', true, 'assets', COALESCE((
  SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT id, name, category, style, tags, prompt_it, prompt_en, object_name, in_inventory,
           to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at
    FROM xr.assets WHERE in_inventory AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY created_at
  ) x), '[]'::json)) AS result;",
  "rename_scene": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j),
up AS (UPDATE xr.scenes SET name = COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p.j->>'name'),''), name), updated_at = now()
       FROM p WHERE id = (p.j->>'scene_id')::uuid AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id, name)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM up)
            THEN json_build_object('ok', true, 'scene_id', (SELECT id FROM up), 'name', (SELECT name FROM up))
            ELSE json_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'Scena non trovata') END AS result;",
  "enrich_assets": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j),
todo AS (
  SELECT id, name, category, style, object_name, created_at FROM xr.assets
  WHERE in_inventory AND deleted_at IS NULL AND cardinality(tags) = 0
),
lim AS (SELECT LEAST(COALESCE(NULLIF((j->>'limit')::int, 0), 3), 10) AS n FROM p)
SELECT json_build_object('ok', true,
  'remaining', (SELECT count(*) FROM todo),
  'assets', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
      SELECT id, name, category, style, object_name FROM todo ORDER BY created_at LIMIT (SELECT n FROM lim)) x), '[]'::json)) AS result;",
  "register_asset": "WITH p AS (SELECT $xrq${P}$xrq$::jsonb AS j),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO xr.assets (id, name, category, style, tags, prompt_it, prompt_en, object_name, model,
                         glb_key, image_key, thumb_key, width_cm, height_cm, depth_cm, glb_bytes,
                         gen_image_s, gen_model_s, author, in_inventory)
  SELECT (j->>'id')::uuid, COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'name',''), 'Oggetto'), COALESCE(j->>'category',''), COALESCE(j->>'style',''),
         COALESCE(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(j->'tags','[]'::jsonb))), '{}'),
         COALESCE(j->>'prompt_it',''), COALESCE(j->>'prompt_en',''), COALESCE(j->>'object_name',''), COALESCE(j->>'model',''),
         j->>'glb_key', COALESCE(j->>'image_key',''), COALESCE(j->>'thumb_key',''),
         COALESCE((j->>'width_cm')::real,0), COALESCE((j->>'height_cm')::real,0), COALESCE((j->>'depth_cm')::real,0),
         COALESCE((j->>'glb_bytes')::bigint,0), COALESCE((j->>'gen_image_s')::real,0), COALESCE((j->>'gen_model_s')::real,0),
         COALESCE(j->>'author',''), COALESCE((j->>'in_inventory')::boolean, false)
  FROM p
  RETURNING id, name, category, style, tags, prompt_it, prompt_en, object_name, model,
       glb_key, image_key, thumb_key, width_cm, height_cm, depth_cm, glb_bytes,
       author, in_inventory, use_count, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at
)
SELECT json_build_object('ok', true, 'asset', row_to_json(ins)) AS result FROM ins;"
};
const sql = (route === 'save_asset' || route === 'search') ? '' : Q[route].split('{P}').join(p);

return [{ json: { action, route, payload, sql, thumb_base64: b.thumb_base64 ?? '' } }];
